GME 202 | الكود: GME 202 ---

English

This comprehensive course provides educators and training program leaders with the framework, tools, and practical strategies needed to design effective educational experiences in healthcare quality improvement. Participants will explore curriculum development principles, adult learning theory, experiential learning models, and assessment strategies specifically adapted for Graduate Medical Education in Saudi Arabia. The curriculum integrates international best practices with local regulatory requirements, including SCFHS program accreditation standards, CBAHI educational requirements, and Vision 2030 quality transformation initiatives. Estimated Time of Completion: 2 hours | المدة المقدرة للإنجاز: ساعتان

العربية

تقدم هذه الدورة الشاملة للمنظمين وقادة برامج التدريب الإطار والأدوات والاستراتيجيات العملية اللازمة لتصميم تجارب تعليمية فعالة في تحسين جودة الرعاية الصحية. سيستكشف المشاركون مبادئ تطوير المناهج، ونظرية تعلم البالغين، ونماذج التعلم التجريبي، واستراتيجيات التقييم المصممة خصيصاً للتعليم الطبي العالي في المملكة العربية السعودية. يتكامل المنهج مع أفضل الممارسات الدولية والمتطلبات التنظيمية المحلية، بما في ذلك معايير اعتماد برامج الهيئة السعودية للتخصصات الصحية، ومتطلبات التعليم لـ CBAHI، ومبادرات التحول النوعي في جودة رؤية ٢٠٣٠. ---

English Learning Outcomes

Upon successful completion of this course, learners will be able to: 1. Design curriculum that integrates quality improvement and patient safety competencies into graduate medical education programs 2. Apply adult learning principles to create engaging, effective educational experiences for resident physicians 3. Implement experiential learning models including simulation, QI projects, and workplace-based learning 4. Develop assessment frameworks that align with ACGME milestones and SCFHS requirements 5. Create evaluation systems to measure educational effectiveness and program outcomes 6. Utilize instructional design tools including learning objectives, content mapping, and educational technology 7. Design faculty development programs to enhance teaching and supervision skills 8. Adapt international best practices to Saudi healthcare educational context

مخرجات التعلم بالعربية

عند إتمام هذه الدورة بنجاح، سيتمكن المتعلمون من: 1. تصميم مناهج دراسية تدمج كفاءات تحسين الجودة وسلامة المرضى في برامج التعليم الطبي العالي 2. تطبيق مبادئ تعلم البالغين لإنشاء تجارب تعليمية جذابة وفعالة لأطباء الإقامة 3. تنفيذ نماذج التعلم التجريبي بما في ذلك المحاكاة ومشاريع QI والتعلم القائم على مكان العمل 4. تطوير أطر تقييم تتوافق مع معالم ACGME ومتطلبات SCFHS 5. إنشاء أنظمة تقييم لقياس فعالية التعليم ونتائج البرنامج 6. استخدام أدوات تصميم التعليم بما في ذلك أهداف التعلم وربط المحتوى والتكنولوجيا التعليمية 7. تصميم برامج تطوير أعضاء هيئة التدريس لتعزيز مهارات التدريس والإشراف 8. تكييف أفضل الممارسات الدولية لل سياق التعليمي الصحي السعودي ---

Instructions: Design a 60-minute teaching session on a QI topic for your resident cohort. Exercise 2: Curriculum Mapping Exercise

Instructions: Create a curriculum map for your residency program aligning learning experiences with milestones. Required Elements: 1. List of core rotations 2. Learning objectives for each rotation 3. Alignment with ACGME milestones 4. Assessment methods for each objective 5. Identification of gaps and redundancies ---

Case Study: Implementing a New QI Curriculum at King Saud Medical Complex

Setting: King Saud Medical Complex, Riyadh Challenge: Integrate QI methodology into Internal Medicine residency program Situation: Dr. Sarah Al-Mutairi, Program Director of Internal Medicine at King Saud Medical Complex, identifies that residents are not adequately prepared to participate in quality improvement initiatives. The hospital has ambitious quality targets under Vision 2030, but the training program lacks formal QI curriculum. Your Task: 1. Conduct needs assessment using Kern's six-step approach 2. Design curriculum integrating ACGME competencies 3. Select appropriate teaching methods 4. Develop assessment framework 5. Create implementation plan with timeline 6. Design evaluation system Stakeholders to Consider: - Residency program leadership - Quality and patient safety department - Clinical faculty - Residents at all levels - Hospital administration - SCFHS accreditation requirements ---

Quiz 1: Curriculum Design

Q1: Which Kern step involves identifying educational needs? - A) Step 1: Problem Identification - B) Step 2: Needs Assessment - C) Step 3: Goals and Objectives - D) Step 4: Educational Strategies Q2: The explicit curriculum refers to: - A) Hidden cultural influences - B) Written, official learning goals - C) Learning outside formal instruction - D) Social development aspects Q3: Curriculum alignment requires: - A) Matching content to objectives - B) Random content selection - C) Ignoring regulatory requirements - D) Avoiding assessment integration

Quiz 2: Adult Learning

Q1: According to Knowles' andragogy, adults prefer: - A) Teacher-directed learning - B) Subject-centered content - C) Problem-centered learning - D) Uniform pacing Q2: Kolb's concrete experience stage involves: - A) Theory development - B) Hands-on activities - C) Abstract conceptualization - D) Reflection Q3: Self-determination theory identifies three basic needs: - A) Autonomy, competence, relatedness - B) Power, achievement, affiliation - C) Security, belonging, esteem - D) Growth, recognition, status

Quiz 3: Assessment

Q1: Formative assessment purpose is: - A) Certification - B) Guiding learning - C) Ranking students - D) Sorting for training Q2: OSCE stands for: - A) Objective Structured Clinical Examination - B) Organized Systematic Competency Evaluation - C) Overall Student Clinical Experience - D) Operational Standards for Clinical Education Q3: Portfolio assessment is valuable because: - A) It replaces all other methods - B) It provides rich, longitudinal evidence - C) It requires minimal time - D) It is completely standardized ---
